hero.note: wide: 10 single and 6 group pictures, all official, 16:9 by `clean` (the shared `p` of the wall, no new file). portrait: ten 4:5 cards, one for each Aspirant, then eight more official stills cut to 4:5 (hero_cards.py), new files.

single.title: Fanny, Blade of Kibou
single.alt: Fanny with orange hair in a high ponytail leaps through a bright blue sky with a thin blade in each hand and a glass city behind her.

single.title: Ruby, Mecha Maiden
single.alt: Ruby with dark hair and pink ends swings a huge white and orange blade over a blue night city, with dark machine hands reaching in from the right.

single.title: Lesley, Deadeye Spectre
single.alt: Lesley with long blonde hair dives through the air above a pale city, aiming an orange and gold cannon with a large red and orange wing module behind her.

single.title: Guinevere, Daybreak Halo
single.alt: Guinevere with long pale hair that fades to violet and a red bow leaps through the sky with gold star blades, round droids and glowing red crystals around her.

single.title: Selena, Silverbolt Raiko
single.alt: Selena with long golden hair and small horns flies forward with a grin in a blue and silver mecha suit, with small chibi faces floating in the corners.

single.title: Layla, Miss Hikari
single.alt: Layla with long pink twin tails kneels behind a long white cannon while a round black droid with a cyan face floats in the foreground.

single.title: Angela, Cyber Cherubin
single.alt: Angela with peach pink twin tails and large pink and white rabbit ear headphones sits in a sunny rest area at 8:31 AM, with a small chibi companion, a floating drone and a cup of bubble tea.

single.title: Chang'e, Tech Tensai
single.alt: Chang'e with pink twin tails, a green streak, round glasses and rabbit ears reaches out from a white mecha in front of a glowing blue ring, with a city and distant flying shapes behind her.

single.title: Vexana, Twilight Star
single.alt: Vexana with silver blue hair stands on a rooftop at night in front of a huge dark mecha that holds a giant violet sword.

single.title: Obsidia, Imperatrix Arashi
single.alt: Obsidia with long blonde and pink hair in a black gown raises one gloved hand in a ring of dark red light, a silver and pink weapon at her side.

fanart.note: Fan work, shown with its credit. Where a picture is shown as content use CanonBadge (canon "fan" prints "Fan work") and CreditLine (features/library/shell/credit.tsx: `<by> on <platform>` and a "View the original" link from credit.url). On hover over a floating picture show the badge and the credit line. The section carries one small ReportLink (features/legal/takedown/report-link.tsx, "Copyright or takedown") for the section and one in the preview of a picture (item = {id, title}). `artistLink` is the text of the credit's link, which is the artist's own name as the post gives it. Two group pictures with no named artist (fanart-4f2cc3ba, fanart-e5d39833) are left out.

trailer.note: The strip and its window play the library's whole film (`film.lib.video`, H.264 faststart, range requests) in a streamed <video> that buffers seconds ahead: never held whole. The picture is 1920x808 (2.376 to 1) and the window takes that shape, no crop. It rests at `start` and loops there. The loading bar waits for `warm.seconds` of it.
